Pros: 

- They have a great color selection so you're bound to find 
your perfect shade. 
- The coverage is medium to full depending on your 
application. 
- It is long lasting even without primer or a setting spray. 

Cons:
- Depending on your application, it can streak and look cakey. 

For reference, I have mature oily acne prone skin with some acne scarring on my cheeks. And I've found that it's best to method of application for this foundation is to apply it with a flat foundation brush in downward strokes for a seamless application. Other brushes and methods did not work for this foundation except for this one. I also found two pumps of foundation gave me a very even and full coverage application and it applied more evenly without the need of a primer. Overall, I've been wearing this foundation for a solid six months and it's performed extremely well, especially in the hot humid months here in the Midwest. Even through excessive sweating and a downpour it still held up.
